row.proto: void Ui_Set_DynamicProperty_ByName(void *target, const char *name, void *value, void *allocator)
row.notes: Whole body read. NULL name sets errno 0x16. Lazily allocates the 0x60-byte property map at target+0x10 from allocator (hash seed 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53, group width 0x20); if the map has an alias pool (+0x50) the name is first looked up with Ne_StringPool_FindObjectByCStr and replaced by the alias string when its type is 0x14612bad8. Hashes the name with djb2 (0x1505, x33) and probes the map: on a hit whose value type id equals type 0x14612bf38 it tail-calls value vt+0x40(value_obj, value); type mismatch sets errno 0x58. On a miss it creates a value object through type 0x14612bf38 vt+8(map allocator), sets it via vt+0x40 and inserts {hash, obj} (0x1438f5f80, grow 0x1438f6240), freeing it and setting errno 0x58 if the insert reports a duplicate; alloc failures set errno 0xc. Callers: 0x14424b4f0 and 0x144207540 (pin-target fan-out, one or two name/value pairs per target) and Vm_UiControllerPrompt_Update (names 0x1456f814d and 0x14588d227), always with the allocator from g_Vm_UiSystem vt+8. Good hook to log every named value pushed to UI targets. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
